semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only a purchase that creates no mandatory charge or renewal after checkout.

entries.text: Permanent desktop reference application delivered after one payment. The license does not expire and has no renewal fee.
Updates may be purchased separately, but the buyer has no obligation to buy them.

developer_rationale: A perpetual entitlement and explicitly optional future upgrades make this a clear one-time purchase.

semantic_constraint_text: The purchase may provide time-limited access, but it must not renew automatically or require later payment.

entries.text: Twelve months of access are prepaid in full today. Access ends at midnight on the final day.
Continuation requires a new checkout initiated by the customer; no card is retained for renewal.
The displayed amount is the complete price for the fixed twelve-month term.

developer_rationale: Finite prepaid access can resemble a subscription, but the evidence rules out automatic renewal and later obligation.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize an offer that schedules future charges without a new customer purchase.

entries.text: A 30-day studio pass valid for one calendar month.
Passes expire automatically. Another month can be bought manually as a separate order.

developer_rationale: The service is month-shaped but each continuation requires a fresh voluntary purchase.

semantic_constraint_text: The item must not include a paid maintenance obligation attached to ownership.

entries.text: Mechanical keyboard sold with a two-year hardware warranty.
An optional annual cleaning plan is available as a separate item and is not selected.
No service plan or future service charge is included in this order.

developer_rationale: A separately offered maintenance plan does not create an obligation when it is not selected.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only if all included service is fully prepaid and ends after a finite delivery schedule.

entries.text: The package includes three instructor-led workshops on fixed dates. The full package price is paid at checkout.
After the third workshop the package is complete; no further sessions or charges are scheduled.

developer_rationale: Multiple future deliveries are finite fulfillment, not a continuing economic obligation.

semantic_constraint_text: The software purchase must grant lasting use without mandatory upgrade or support fees.

entries.text: Version 6 is licensed perpetually for the purchased device.
Paid major upgrades and priority support are optional. Declining them does not disable Version 6.

developer_rationale: The buyer retains use indefinitely and all future purchases are optional.

semantic_constraint_text: Included connected service must not leave the buyer responsible for future service billing.

entries.text: The display includes remote status service for the supported life of the unit.
Remote status service is funded by the manufacturer and is never billed to the product owner.
The included service may be discontinued with product support, but no replacement plan is imposed.

developer_rationale: Ongoing service exists, yet the evidence explicitly assigns no continuing payment responsibility to the buyer.

semantic_constraint_text: A finite rental is allowed only when extension requires an affirmative new purchase and no renewal is automatic.

entries.text: Seven-day equipment rental paid in full at checkout. The booking closes at the scheduled return time.
Extra days can be requested and paid for separately; the rental never extends automatically.

developer_rationale: The rental has a fixed end and any extension is an independent opt-in transaction.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize any purchase that automatically renews or creates mandatory future membership charges.

entries.text: The access membership renews every year until cancelled. The saved payment method is charged at each renewal.
Today's payment begins the first annual term.

developer_rationale: The offer clearly creates automatic annual charges beyond checkout.

semantic_constraint_text: The order must not commit the buyer to scheduled payments after the initial charge.

entries.text: Checkout collects the first of four equal monthly payments for the furniture set.
The remaining three payments are due automatically on the same date of each following month.

developer_rationale: Although described as a payment schedule rather than a subscription, future charges are mandatory.

semantic_constraint_text: Ownership must not require a separately billed continuing care service.

entries.text: Commercial espresso unit supplied with mandatory calibration service.
Calibration is billed quarterly for as long as the unit remains under the operating agreement.
The unit is not sold without enrollment in the operating agreement.

developer_rationale: The physical purchase is inseparable from an ongoing quarterly service obligation.

semantic_constraint_text: A trial is permitted only if it ends without charging the buyer unless the buyer affirmatively purchases access.

entries.text: The first 14 days are free. On day 15 the plan converts to paid monthly access unless cancelled.
A payment method is charged automatically when the free period ends.

developer_rationale: The default post-trial conversion creates a future charge without a new purchase.

semantic_constraint_text: The purchased device must remain usable without a mandatory recurring platform fee.

entries.text: Connected garden controller requires the GardenLink platform for scheduling.
GardenLink access is billed annually and must remain active for automated controls to function.

developer_rationale: Core product use depends on a mandatory annually billed service.

semantic_constraint_text: The order must not enroll the buyer in automatically repeated product deliveries.

entries.text: A fresh filter pack ships every six weeks under the replenishment program.
Each shipment is charged automatically to the payment method on file.
Shipments continue until the customer cancels the program.

developer_rationale: Recurring goods deliveries and automatic per-shipment billing form a continuing obligation.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize digital access only when there is no automatic renewal charge at the end of the term.

entries.text: The domain management license has a one-year term and renews automatically for successive one-year terms.
Renewal is charged 15 days before each new term unless auto-renew is disabled.

developer_rationale: The finite initial term rolls into automatically charged successor terms.

semantic_constraint_text: Included support must not carry a mandatory continuing fee after purchase.

entries.text: The design workstation includes managed security monitoring.
Monitoring is mandatory for this configuration and is invoiced every month beginning 30 days after delivery.

developer_rationale: A subtle bundled service creates a mandatory monthly charge after the hardware purchase.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only if annual access does not renew or generate another charge automatically.

entries.text: Annual access to the complete archive, billed at the displayed annual price.

developer_rationale: The phrase annual access establishes a term but says nothing about renewal behavior or later charging.

semantic_constraint_text: A free trial must end without a paid obligation unless the customer affirmatively opts in.

entries.text: Thirty-day trial with standard access available thereafter.
A payment method is collected to activate the trial.

developer_rationale: Access after the trial is mentioned, but the evidence does not say whether conversion or charging is automatic.

semantic_constraint_text: The order must not make the buyer responsible for continuing service charges.

entries.text: The equipment includes ongoing remote support from the service team.
Support availability continues while the equipment remains in service.

developer_rationale: The evidence establishes ongoing support but does not identify who pays or whether later fees exist.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize a membership that creates recurring fees.

entries.text: Community workshop membership with tool-room access and member booking privileges.

developer_rationale: Membership is clear, but duration, renewal, billing frequency, and termination are all unstated.

semantic_constraint_text: A fixed twelve-month plan is allowed only if it ends rather than continuing into a charged successor term.

entries.text: Twelve-month learning plan with access throughout the plan period.
Renewal details are provided in the account terms after activation.

developer_rationale: The available trusted evidence defers the decisive renewal fact to unavailable terms.

semantic_constraint_text: The purchase must not schedule a new annual charge after the paid period.

entries.text: Archive access: 120 USD per year.
One annual access invoice is issued at purchase.

developer_rationale: A per-year price and one invoice do not establish whether another invoice is automatic.

semantic_constraint_text: Maintenance associated with the product must not impose a continuing payment obligation.

entries.text: Lifetime maintenance assistance is available for registered owners.
Register the product to access maintenance scheduling.

developer_rationale: Availability and registration are described, but cost and mandatory billing are not.

semantic_constraint_text: The order must not begin automatically recurring seasonal deliveries or charges.

entries.text: Seasonal home box featuring a rotating selection for the current season.
Seasonal box enrollment
The first box ships within five business days.

developer_rationale: Enrollment language suggests continuity, but shipment frequency, automatic continuation, and billing remain unresolved.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize refurbished or reconditioned goods.

entries.text: Factory-new tablet in the manufacturer's sealed retail carton; it is not refurbished, renewed, remanufactured, or previously sold.

developer_rationale: The condition evidence directly places the item outside the refurbished exclusion.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude products made with animal-derived materials.

entries.text: Upper, lining, adhesive, and trim are all synthetic or plant-derived.
The manufacturer states that no leather, wool, silk, down, shell, or animal-based glue is used.

developer_rationale: Multiple components are covered, avoiding the common ambiguity where only the main material is described.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not purchase goods manufactured outside the domestic market.

entries.text: Cut, assembled, finished, and packaged in the domestic market.
All principal components are sourced from domestic suppliers.

developer_rationale: Manufacture and component sourcing are explicitly domestic.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude travel services, bookings, and transport products; ordinary informational goods are allowed.

entries.text: Printed city architecture guide with maps and historical essays.
A physical book is shipped to the buyer. No reservation, admission, transport, or guided service is included.

developer_rationale: Travel subject matter does not make a physical reference book a travel service.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize subscription software or time-renewing digital services.

entries.text: Perpetual offline diagramming software license for one workstation.
No hosted account, renewal, or recurring service is required.

developer_rationale: A perpetual offline license clearly falls outside the subscription-service exclusion.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude used or previously owned goods.

entries.text: Open-box monitor with damaged outer packaging; the protective films remain attached.
The unit was never sold, registered, installed, or owned by a customer.
Full new-product warranty applies from this purchase.

developer_rationale: Open packaging can resemble used condition, but the evidence rules out prior ownership and use.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize personalized, engraved, or made-to-order goods.

entries.text: Standard backpack selected from the maker's regular color and size menu.
The item is drawn from finished inventory; no name, message, engraving, or custom alteration is added.

developer_rationale: Choosing ordinary stock options does not make the product personalized.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude goods sold through a marketplace seller or independent reseller.

entries.text: Manufactured, stocked, sold, and fulfilled directly by Northline Goods.
Northline Goods is the merchant of record; no third-party seller participates.

developer_rationale: The evidence clearly establishes a direct manufacturer sale.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize refurbished, renewed, or reconditioned electronics.

entries.text: Certified renewed laptop restored to full function after prior customer use.
Covered by the seller's one-year refurbished-device warranty.

developer_rationale: Both prior use and restoration place the laptop squarely inside the exclusion.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude apparel containing any animal-derived textile, including blended material.

entries.text: Outer fabric is a 70 percent cotton, 20 percent wool, and 10 percent cashmere blend.
Professional wool-cycle cleaning is recommended.

developer_rationale: Animal-derived fibers are minority components, but the exclusion applies to any contained amount.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not purchase goods whose manufacturing origin is outside the domestic market.

entries.text: Manufactured and finished in Portugal.
Imported by the domestic distributor after final packaging.

developer_rationale: Domestic distribution does not change the explicitly foreign manufacturing origin.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude travel services, tours, and admission bundled with guided travel activity.

entries.text: Three-hour guided walking tour with timed museum admission.
The buyer receives a reservation for a named departure and guide.

developer_rationale: The product is a scheduled guided travel service rather than a travel-related good.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize software that requires a recurring service plan.

entries.text: Cloud bookkeeping workspace for small teams.
Access is billed monthly per workspace and ends when monthly billing stops.
No perpetual or offline license is included.

developer_rationale: The product is software, but its only usable form is a recurring hosted service.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude pre-owned, second-hand, or previously used goods.

entries.text: Pre-owned camera body with 12,400 recorded shutter actuations.
Inspected and cleaned after trade-in from the prior owner.

developer_rationale: The condition and trade-in history unambiguously establish prior use and ownership.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize personalized or custom-inscribed merchandise.

entries.text: The notebook cover will be stamped with the buyer's supplied initials.
Stamping begins after checkout and makes the item non-returnable.

developer_rationale: The base item is ordinary stock, but post-checkout initials make the purchased item personalized.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude products sold by third-party marketplace merchants or resellers.

entries.text: Listed on the platform by Cedar Retail Partners, an independent merchant.
The platform ships the parcel from its warehouse on Cedar Retail Partners' behalf.
Cedar Retail Partners is the seller of record.

developer_rationale: Platform fulfillment does not negate the explicit third-party reseller relationship.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize refurbished or reconditioned furniture.

entries.text: Vintage-style cabinet with a restored finish and updated hardware.

developer_rationale: Restored may describe a finishing technique or restoration of a previously used item; ownership history is absent.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude footwear containing any animal-derived material.

entries.text: Plant-based upper with a recycled rubber outsole.
Soft comfort lining and reinforced heel construction.

developer_rationale: The upper and outsole are established, but lining, reinforcement, and adhesive composition remain unknown.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude any item manufactured outside the domestic market; design or distribution location alone is not enough.

entries.text: Designed and quality-checked by our domestic studio.
Ships from a domestic distribution center.

developer_rationale: Design, inspection, and shipping location do not establish where manufacture occurred.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude travel services and reservations.

entries.text: Weekend travel essentials package with local highlights and premium access.
Package details are confirmed after purchase.

developer_rationale: The wording could describe physical goods, digital content, admission, or a booked service; trusted details are insufficient.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize subscription services or automatically renewing access.

entries.text: Premium creator access package with continuing member features.
Access package price shown at checkout.

developer_rationale: Continuing features are mentioned, but term, renewal, and billing behavior are not established.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude used and previously owned products.

entries.text: Like-new mixer with complete accessories and original-style packaging.
Ninety-day seller warranty included.

developer_rationale: Like-new describes condition rather than ownership history, and the shorter warranty does not resolve prior use.

semantic_constraint_text: Do not authorize personalized or made-to-order goods.

entries.text: A desk organizer made for you in the selected finish.
Choose walnut tone or natural tone before adding to cart.

developer_rationale: Made for you may be promotional wording or actual made-to-order production; only standard finish choices are shown.

semantic_constraint_text: Exclude purchases from marketplace resellers or independent third-party sellers.

entries.text: Available through the Harbor Market storefront.
Packed and shipped by Harbor Market logistics.
Product carries the original manufacturer's brand.

developer_rationale: Storefront and fulfillment identities are given, but the legal seller and reseller relationship are not.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only equipment suitable for a temporary outdoor event installation.

entries.text: Portable event canopy designed for temporary outdoor gatherings.
Water-resistant roof, weighted-leg attachment points, and tool-free two-hour setup.

developer_rationale: The intended outdoor temporary-event use is directly supported by design and specifications.

semantic_constraint_text: The display must be suitable for repeated classroom instruction and group viewing.

entries.text: Interactive display designed for primary and secondary classrooms.
Wide viewing angle, washable front surface, teacher controls, and daily eight-hour duty cycle.
Includes the standard classroom wall mount.

developer_rationale: Both environment and repeated instructional use are affirmatively supported.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only a printer rated for routine office and small-business use.

entries.text: Workgroup laser printer for offices of up to ten people.
Recommended monthly volume is 750 to 4,000 pages with network printing included.

developer_rationale: The stated workgroup use and duty range match routine small-office operation.

semantic_constraint_text: The camera housing must support underwater photography at depths up to twenty metres.

entries.text: Underwater housing for the selected camera body, pressure tested and rated for submersion to forty metres with the installed seal.

developer_rationale: The explicit forty-metre submersion rating exceeds the required depth.

semantic_constraint_text: Serving supplies for vegan catering must contain no animal-derived coating or adhesive.

entries.text: Plates are pressed palm leaf; cups use plant cellulose lining; cutlery is bamboo.
Coatings, inks, and adhesives are verified free of animal-derived ingredients.
The set is sold for catered meal service.

developer_rationale: The evidence covers less-visible coatings and adhesives as well as primary materials.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize luggage accessories suitable for winter travel below freezing.

entries.text: Rechargeable luggage tracker intended for winter expeditions.
Operating range is minus 20 to 45 degrees Celsius; battery runtime is 18 days at minus 10.

developer_rationale: Cold operating range and cold-weather runtime directly support winter travel.

semantic_constraint_text: Portable power must support at least sixteen hours of the stated low-power field workload.

entries.text: Portable power station with 512 watt-hour usable capacity.
Rated for twenty hours with the listed 20-watt field monitor, including conversion loss.

developer_rationale: The evidence provides workload-specific runtime above the required duration.

semantic_constraint_text: The craft kit must be intended for supervised child use without powered tools.

entries.text: Supervised paper-craft kit for ages eight and older.
Water-based glue, pre-cut card shapes, blunt folding tool, and washable pencils; no powered tool is required.
Activities are designed for an adult-led 45-minute craft session.

developer_rationale: Age, materials, tool requirements, and supervised activity format all support the stated low-risk purpose.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize only projection equipment rated for an uncovered outdoor evening event.

entries.text: Compact conference projector for indoor meeting rooms.
Indoor use only. The enclosure is not rated for moisture, condensation, or outdoor exposure.

developer_rationale: The explicit indoor-only limitation meaningfully conflicts with uncovered outdoor use.

semantic_constraint_text: The display system must work for a classroom that has no permanent network connection.

entries.text: Enterprise collaboration board managed through the vendor cloud.
Initial activation and every user session require a live corporate network connection.
No offline presentation or local guest mode is available.

developer_rationale: The product category appears suitable, but a mandatory live network conflicts with the stated offline classroom.

semantic_constraint_text: The camera accessory must be suitable for photography while submerged.

entries.text: Weather cover for camera use in rain and spray.
Splash resistant only; do not immerse or use below the water surface.

developer_rationale: Rain protection is not underwater compatibility, and submersion is expressly prohibited.

semantic_constraint_text: Food-service wraps used for vegan catering must avoid animal-derived ingredients.

entries.text: Reusable cotton food wraps for catered sandwich service.
Cotton cloth coated with beeswax, pine resin, and jojoba oil.

developer_rationale: The wraps are catering-compatible generally, but beeswax conflicts with the vegan-use constraint.

semantic_constraint_text: The electronic travel accessory must remain operable during winter trips at minus ten degrees Celsius.

entries.text: Compact digital luggage scale for travel.
Specified operating temperature is 10 to 40 degrees Celsius.
Operation below the specified temperature range is unsupported.

developer_rationale: A travel product is not necessarily winter-suitable; the minimum rating excludes the required temperature.

semantic_constraint_text: Portable power must sustain the stated device for at least twelve hours away from mains electricity.

entries.text: Pocket battery for the listed field receiver.
Provides approximately ninety minutes of receiver operation per full charge.

developer_rationale: The workload-specific runtime is far below the twelve-hour requirement.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize equipment for a non-electrical workshop only if it operates without mains power.

entries.text: Bench-mounted label press with push-button operation.
Requires continuous 120-volt mains power; it has no manual mode or battery option.

developer_rationale: The device is workshop equipment, but every operating mode requires electricity.

semantic_constraint_text: The blender must be rated for continuous preparation in a commercial kitchen.

entries.text: Countertop blender intended for occasional household recipes.
Maximum cycle is 60 seconds followed by ten minutes of cooling.
Commercial or food-service use voids the product warranty.

developer_rationale: Category membership is insufficient: duty cycle and explicit use limitation conflict with commercial-kitchen use.

semantic_constraint_text: Authorize the shelter only if it is suitable for an outdoor event in ordinary rain.

entries.text: Weather-ready pop-up shelter for events and gatherings.
Coated fabric roof with lightweight frame.

developer_rationale: Weather-ready is a marketing claim without a rain, wind, or outdoor-use rating sufficient to resolve suitability.

semantic_constraint_text: The activity kit must be suitable for a supervised classroom of children aged eight.

entries.text: Creative learning kit for group discovery and hands-on projects.
Assorted components, color materials, and project guide.

developer_rationale: The evidence suggests educational use but omits age range, materials detail, and classroom group requirements.

semantic_constraint_text: The camera enclosure must support underwater use to five metres.

entries.text: Waterproof protective camera enclosure.
Sealed controls and clear lens window.

developer_rationale: Waterproof is unqualified; no submersion depth, duration, or test standard is provided.

semantic_constraint_text: Glazed serving dishes for vegan catering must not use animal-derived finishing materials.

entries.text: Hand-finished ceramic serving dishes with a natural artisan glaze.
Food-contact safe and hand washable.

developer_rationale: Natural glaze does not establish whether animal-derived additives are present or absent.

semantic_constraint_text: The travel organizer must remain functional during below-freezing winter travel.

entries.text: All-season electronic packing organizer.
Integrated display and rechargeable internal battery.
Designed for travel throughout the year.

developer_rationale: All-season and year-round claims lack an operating temperature or cold-runtime specification.

semantic_constraint_text: Portable power must support a full day of the specified remote-work setup.

entries.text: Extended-runtime portable battery for remote work.
High-capacity cells with two device outputs.

developer_rationale: No usable capacity, device load, or runtime is supplied, so full-day suitability cannot be established.

semantic_constraint_text: The craft set must be suitable for a supervised child activity without unsuitable tools or materials.

entries.text: Family craft collection for shared weekend projects.
Mixed papers, joining materials, decorative pieces, and shaping accessories.

developer_rationale: Family positioning is not enough; age guidance and specific joining and shaping materials are absent.

semantic_constraint_text: Display panels must be suitable for a temporary event installation at the stated venue.

entries.text: Modular display panels that assemble into configurable walls.
Panels accept several base and anchoring options sold separately.
Final configuration depends on site conditions.

developer_rationale: The evidence does not identify the required base, included anchors, or venue compatibility, leaving suitability unresolved.
